INTRO_KR: Chully Chocolate was officially established in 2021, specializing in liquor-filled chocolate products. The creative concept merges Eastern (Asian) renowned liquors with Western (European) chocolate. The idea of creating liquor-filled chocolate using China's famous Moutai liquor from Guizhou began in 2013. In 2019, we rented a small workshop to start development, exploring whether Eastern liquors and chocolate could create an irresistible delicacy. This journey culminated in the creation of our first Moutai-filled chocolate, affirming our direction for this chocolate product. As a startup, our current production method is handcrafted, but this is not the final goal for Chully. We hope that once our products gain market recognition, we can shift our focus to mass production, aiming to bring Hong Kong-made chocolates to the global stage. Currently, we are collaborating with specialty stores for Moutai, Wuliangye, and Xijiu in Hong Kong, and we have also partnered with automotive companies. We aspire to be a Hong Kong brand that embodies Eastern culture, allowing more friends to indulge in our meticulously crafted liquor-filled chocolates.

The creative concept merges Eastern (Asian) renowned liquors with Western (European) chocolate. In 2019, we rented a small workshop to start development, exploring whether Eastern liquors and chocolate could create an irresistible delicacy. This journey culminated in the creation of our first Moutai-filled chocolate, affirming our direction for this chocolate product. As a startup, our current production method is handcrafted, but this is not the final goal for Chully. We hope that once our products gain market recognition, we can shift our focus to mass production, aiming to bring Hong Kong-made chocolates to the global stage. Currently, we are collaborating with specialty stores for Moutai, Wuliangye, and Xijiu in Hong Kong, and we have also partnered with automotive companies. We aspire to be a Hong Kong brand that embodies Eastern culture, allowing more friends to indulge in our meticulously crafted liquor-filled chocolates.

INTRO_KR: Hong Kong Craft Distilling Co. is set up with a mission to build a community that appreciates craft spirits and bring to the world a gin that represents Hong Kong. Although ultimately we plan to venture into other spirits, our distillery predominately focuses on craft gin, with N.I.P being the first brand under the company. The brand N.I.P is designed to emphasize on our interpretation of what a "Hong Kong spirit" is all about. Created by our two "Not-Important-Persons", Nic & Jeremy, N.I.P. represents a value that they firmly believe in. Through grit, belief and persistence, anyone can achieve their dreams and passion as long as one is willing to take that leap of faith, especially in a place like Hong Kong where a conforming mindset dominates. This also lays the background for the story of our founders, who came from humble backgrounds, setting out to pursue their passion in creating a true Hong Kong spirit - their own interpretation of a gin that is truly made in Hong Kong, which integrates the flavours and heritage of the city with traditional techniques of gin production.

INTRO_KR: Hualien County is located in eastern Taiwan and is known for its pure mountains, ocean resources, and diverse cultures. This clean environment produces unique, high-quality agricultural products. The Hualien County Government promotes sustainable and eco-friendly farming. Some products are organic or traceable, showing the county's care for nature. Hualien's main products include rice, pomelos, daylilies, coffee, millet, honey-scented black tea, and indigenous crops and foods. Local farmer's groups and young farmers develop value-added items like tea gift sets, rice snacks, grain drinks, and local specialty foods. In recent years, Hualien has also linked agriculture with tribal experiences, food tourism, and culture, adding stories and value to local products. To help local products reach more markets, the Hualien County Government joins key food shows to connect with buyers and promote the county's clean, diverse farm products to show healthy, natural products like grains, teas, indigenous snacks, and local coffee. The goal is to expand sales, find new buyers, and share Hualien's pure and trusted products with the world.

INTRO_KR: 順昌金牌灌蛋店，坐落於福建省南平市順昌縣，是致力於傳承和弘揚當地特色美食的老店。其主打產品灌蛋，作為南平市傳承百年的非物質文化遺產，承載著深厚的地域文化與美好寓意，在順昌當地乃至全國都享有盛譽。灌蛋形狀像“金元寶”，外白內黃，象徵團圓滿、財源廣進，是順昌人民過年餐桌上必不可少的美食。製作灌蛋的食材十分講究，鴨蛋選用新鮮的放養土鴨蛋，蛋白黏稠不易散開；豬肉則選取豬前腿肉，讓灌蛋口感鮮嫩不柴；再搭配上香菇，巧妙地鎖住豬肉汁水，使其鮮香不膩。順昌金牌灌蛋店的灌蛋製作技藝，由非遺傳承人何丹華精心鑽研、傳承發展，他始終堅持傳統工藝，確保每個灌蛋都原汁原味。店內掛滿了各種榮譽牌匾，如中國烹飪協會的「中餐特色美食名錄證書」、中國飯店協會的「地標美食代表傳承人」、福建省旅遊協會的「八閩旅遊美食」、福建省烹飪協會的「福建名小吃」及「新大餐店閩菜、被「中國閩菜精萃」收入其中、許多媒體對順昌金牌灌蛋進行了宣傳報道，如 CCTV-1《三餐四季 2 福建篇》 、CCTV- 2 《回家吃飯》、 《風味人間 第 2 季》、福建新聞頻道《現場》等，這些都是對金牌灌蛋店品質與口味的高度認可。多年來，順昌金牌灌蛋店始終堅守品質至上，以優質的食材、精湛的技藝和熱情的服務，為食客們帶來地道的順昌灌蛋。不僅深受本地居民的喜愛，也吸引了許多外地遊客慕名而來，成為順昌美食文化的一張閃亮名片 。未來，順昌金牌灌蛋店將繼續傳承和發揚灌蛋文化，讓這份獨特的美味走向更廣闊的天地。
